title: Thompson Rome Opens, Marking the Thompson Hotels Brand’s Debut in Italy
summary: CHICAGO, IL (October 27, 2026) – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced the opening of Thompson Rome, a 69-room hotel owned and operated by AG Group s.r.l. and Rossifin Group,...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO, IL (October 27, 2026)** – Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced the opening of Thompson Rome, a 69-room hotel owned and operated by AG Group s.r.l. and Rossifin Group, marking the Thompson Hotels brand’s debut in Italy. Set within a reimagined iconic landmark on Via delle Botteghe Oscure, the hotel is steps from Piazza Venezia and within walking distance of the Roman Forum, Pantheon and Colosseum, pairing its historic setting with a contemporary approach to art, design and dining.


Thompson Rome draws on the architectural character of its 1940s home and the layered history of Via delle Botteghe Oscure, one of Rome’s most significant streets and a landmark in post-war Italian political history. Original elements, including a sweeping marble staircase, have been carefully restored, while a sculptural wall and inlaid floor by celebrated Italian artist Gio Pomodoro, rediscovered during the renovation after decades hidden from view—have been preserved and given new prominence within the hotel. Bespoke furnishings, refined detailing and layered natural materials bring a contemporary expression to the building's history.


“Rome has such a strong identity, so we wanted Thompson Rome to start with the city itself,” said Amar Lalvani, Chief Creative Officer, Hyatt Corporation and President & Creative Director, The Lifestyle Group, Hyatt. “The building, the neighborhood, the food, the people and the way Romans live all shaped the hotel. The goal was to create a Thompson hotel that feels at home in Rome, a hotel travelers want to discover and Romans want to come back to.


“Rome reveals itself over time, through its neighborhoods, its art and, most importantly, its people. At Thompson Rome, we want guests to feel connected to that side of the city from the moment they arrive,” said Arturo Gomez, general manager. “Whether it’s discovering the artists represented throughout the hotel, sharing an aperitivo on the rooftop or simply asking a member of our team where they would spend an afternoon, our hope is that the hotel becomes a starting point for experiencing Rome in a more personal way. And for those of us who live here, we want it to become a place you return to again and again.”


**Spaces for Art, Culture, and Connection**


Thompson Rome’s art program, creates a dialogue between the history of the site and contemporary art. Located near the ancient Crypta Balbi, a remarkable example of Rome’s layered urban history, the hotel sits in an area shaped over centuries by the movement and exchange of merchants, pilgrims, artists, scholars and travelers from across the Mediterranean and Europe.


The collection brings together works by artists associated with the Scuola Romana and the Scuola di Piazza del Popolo, alongside contemporary artists whose practices reflect Rome’s longstanding cultural openness and international influences including Francesco Del Drago, Giangaetano Patanè, and Guido Strazza. Presented throughout the hotel’s public spaces and guestrooms, the artworks are an integral part of the guest experience, connecting the memory of the site with the creativity of Rome today.


A rotating artist-in-residence program will further extend Thompson Rome’s connection to the city’s creative community through exhibitions, conversations and other cultural programming.


**A Roman Residence, Reinterpreted**


Thompson Rome’s 69 guestrooms and suites take cues from the character of a contemporary Roman residence, pairing warm natural materials with custom furnishings and understated details. With 19 suites, nearly one-third of the hotel’s accommodation offering, guests can choose from Junior Suites, Suites with patios or terraces, and the 104-square-metre Thompson Suite with 80-square-metre private terrace.


Designed as a counterpoint to the energy of the city outside, the rooms feel residential and refined, with select accommodations offering views across Rome’s historic rooftops and landmarks. Several rooms feature balconies overlooking Via delle Botteghe Oscure, while select rooms offer private patios facing Rome’s historic buildings.


**Rome at the Table, and From Above**


Three distinct food and beverage venues carry Thompson Rome from morning espresso and leisurely lunches through aperitivo, dinner and drinks above the city.


At **LYVE Restaurant** , Executive Chef Fabio Fioravanti brings a contemporary Mediterranean approach to ingredients and traditions from the Italian coast and across the region. Seafood is central to the menu, with Mediterranean fish and shellfish alongside dishes that draw on bouillabaisse, rockfish broths, wild coastal herbs and rouille, reworked with a lighter touch while preserving the depth and character of the originals. The same attention extends to the pastry kitchen, where precise technique and contrasting flavors and textures shape the dessert menu.


A native of Ostia, Fioravanti brings more than two decades of international experience, including time with the Alain Ducasse group and at the three-Michelin-starred Le Louis XV – Alain Ducasse at the Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo. At LYVE, that technical precision carries through a dining experience that is refined yet relaxed, with the quality of the ingredients and clarity of the cooking taking center stage.


Above the hotel, **LYVE Rooftop** pairs views across Rome with cocktails, Italian aperitivi and a menu designed for sharing, moving from late afternoon into the evening. The **Lobby Lounge** offers the hotel’s most casual gathering place throughout the day, from coffee and light fare to aperitivo and cocktails.


**An Invitation Into Contemporary Rome**


The hotel will extend the guest experience through a year-round program shaped by Rome’s culinary, artistic and creative communities. Experiences will range from culinary workshops and guided tastings to *Empire of Light,* a photography-led experience from the hotel’s seventh floor that invites guests to discover Rome from above.

**About Thompson Hotels**


Thompson Hotels are a sophisticated home base when traveling, featuring classics done with a refined sensibility and sense of style housed in an environment where culture thrives. These hotels have a head for business, a taste for leisure and are well suited for meetings and events in a polished manner. Enjoy World of Hyatt benefits with eligible stays at Thompson Hotels - discover more here.


**About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of June 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 83 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the Luxury Portfolio, including Park Hyatt®, Alila®, Miraval®, Impression by Secrets, and The Unbound Collection by Hyatt®; the Lifestyle Portfolio, including Andaz®, Thompson Hotels®, The Standard®, Dream® Hotels, The StandardX®, Breathless Resorts & Spas®, JdV by Hyatt®, Bunkhouse® Hotels, and Me and All Hotels; the Inclusive Collection, including Zoëtry® Wellness & Spa Resorts, Hyatt Ziva®, Hyatt Zilara®, Secrets® Resorts & Spas, Dreams® Resorts & Spas, Hyatt Vivid® Hotels & Resorts, Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts®, and Sunscape® Resorts & Spas; the Classics Portfolio, including Grand Hyatt®, Hyatt Regency®, Destination by Hyatt®, Hyatt Centric®, Hyatt Vacation Club®, and Hyatt®; and the Essentials Portfolio, including Caption by Hyatt®, Unscripted by Hyatt, Hyatt Place®, Hyatt House®, Hyatt Studios®, Hyatt Select, and UrCove. Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit[www.hyatt.com](http://www.hyatt.com/) .


**About AG Group**


Founded over 25 years ago by Andrea Girolami (Founder, President & CEO), AG Group is one of Italy’s leading groups specializing in hospitality and inbound tourism. The Group operates across multiple areas of the sector, including hotel management, DMC and tour operating, event management, food & beverage, and hotel consulting. Today, AG Group works across the entire hospitality value chain through three business divisions: AG Hotels, AG Boutique Journey, and AG Hotel Consulting.


**About Rossfin Group**


Rossfin Group is an Italian business group whose history dates back to the 1940s, driven by the vision and entrepreneurial spirit of the Rossi family. Originally established in the railway infrastructure sector, where it has built a strong reputation and established itself as a leading player both nationally and internationally, the Group has progressively expanded its business interests, pursuing a growth strategy rooted in innovation, industrial expertise, and investment diversification.
As part of this diversification strategy, Rossfin Group has also extended its interests into the hospitality and tourism sectors through its involvement in two prestigious properties along the Lazio coastline: Oasi di Kufra in Sabaudia and Circeo Park Hotel in San Felice Circeo, both located in an area renowned for its outstanding natural beauty and tourism appeal.
Guided by a long-term strategic vision, Rossfin Group combines a strong entrepreneurial heritage with a forward-thinking approach to innovation, fostering projects focused on quality, sustainability, and long-term value creation, while contributing to the economic development and enhancement of the destinations in which it operates.
